text: Which consultancies in Perth are best for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation?

sections.text:
For Perth organisations, the strongest shortlist is:

| Consultancy | Best fit | Why consider it |
|---|---|---|
| **Ultron Developments** | Dedicated Power Platform implementation | Perth-based Microsoft consultancy focused on Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint, Power BI and governance. It covers workflow design, approvals, integrations, testing, documentation and ongoing support.[1][2] |
| **CG TECH** | Microsoft 365 automation plus AI | Works with Perth businesses and public-sector teams on Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Copilot and AI agents. Its Perth examples include a SharePoint–Power Automate integration for a regulated electricity-transmission operator.[3] |
| **Interfuze** | Governance, enablement and larger Microsoft projects | Perth-based consultancy offering Power Platform and Azure development, implementation support, business analysis and project management. It also reports delivering Power Platform governance and training for a WA government department.[4] |
| **Austin Technology** | Automation bundled with managed IT and cybersecurity | Perth engineering team providing Power Automate workflows across Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and business applications, alongside Microsoft 365, security and managed IT services.[5] |
| **Alphavima Technologies** | Structured, fixed-scope Power Platform delivery | Offers Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages, with a stated process covering discovery, design, build, deployment, training and post-launch support.[6] |
| **VibeZero** | Smaller, practical SMB automation projects | Perth-based consultancy focused on Microsoft 365 automation, Power Automate, integrations and AI, with an emphasis on measurable time savings and handover.[7] |

**Best overall starting points:**  
- Choose **Ultron** for a specialist, end-to-end Power Automate or Power Platform implementation.  
- Choose **Interfuze** where governance, organisational enablement or public-sector experience is important.  
- Choose **CG TECH** if the project combines workflow automation with Copilot, AI agents or document-heavy processes.  
- Choose **Austin Technology** if you want automation delivered by the same provider as IT, cybersecurity and Microsoft 365 support.

When comparing proposals, ask each consultancy to demonstrate:

- Experience with your systems, such as SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics, Xero, SAP or bespoke applications.
- How it handles environment strategy, permissions, data loss prevention and the Power Platform Centre of Excellence.
- Error handling, retries, monitoring, audit trails and support after go-live.
- Whether licensing costs, connector costs and RPA requirements are included.
- A working pilot with measurable outcomes, such as hours saved, reduced errors or faster approvals.
- Documentation and internal training so your team is not dependent on the consultant.
